evals.name: collision-scan-one-skill
evals.prompt: I think fix-until-green and loop-controller keep stealing each other's triggers. can you check with jev which of fix-until-green's trigger phrases actually land on it?
evals.expected_output: Runs `triage.py collisions --skill fix-until-green` (dry-run first), reports accuracy, stealers and thin margins with the served model and cost, and gives a one-line verdict per miss (description fix / label fix / ambiguity) without editing any description unasked.
assertions: Made at least one live Jev (systemone) call scoped to fix-until-green's trigger phrases
Report states a per-phrase or aggregate result (N/M landed on fix-until-green)
Report names which skill wins any phrase that does not land on fix-until-green (or says none)
Report includes the served model and the cost of the run
No repo file was modified and no API key value appears in outputs

evals.name: routing-table-regression
evals.prompt: I just added a bunch of skills. Run the skill-explorer routing table through the triage check and tell me what's misrouting now.
evals.expected_output: Runs `check --from-routing-table` against skills/meta/skill-explorer/references/routing-table.md after a dry-run, reports N/M, lists misses with verdicts, notes skipped phrases whose targets are outside the catalog, and pins or reports the model.
assertions: Ran the routing-table cases from skills/meta/skill-explorer/references/routing-table.md through live Jev
Report gives an accuracy figure (N/M correct)
Report lists each misroute with expected and actual skill
Report gives a verdict per miss (description fix vs label/routing-table fix vs ambiguity)
Report mentions phrases skipped because their target is outside the catalog
No repo file was modified and no API key value appears in outputs

evals.name: no-key-or-no-credits
evals.prompt: which skill should fire for 'set up structured logging and tracing for the api service'? use typesafe to decide
evals.expected_output: Looks for the key name in env/.env without printing it; on a missing key or HTTP 402 it reports that plainly, does NOT fabricate probabilities, and falls back to a judgment-based pick clearly labeled as not from Jev.
assertions: Located a usable key by name without printing its value (or reported plainly that none exists)
Made a live Jev call and reports a winner skill with probabilities or confidence
Picked observability-agent (the catalog's logging/metrics/tracing role) or justified a different pick from Jev's output
Does not present any probability that was not returned by the API
No repo file was modified and no API key value appears in outputs
